tasks.description: Lists the MCP servers in project client configs with transport, launcher and approval status. Use when asked for an inventory of the configured MCP servers.
tasks.intent: Inventory configured MCP servers and check them against the approved list.

tasks.description: Reports risky MCP server launch settings such as shell wrappers, sudo and privileged containers against a launch policy. Use when asked for a risky launch command report on MCP configs.
tasks.intent: Report risky MCP server launch settings by severity.

tasks.description: Finds MCP servers launched from packages or container images without an exact version. Use when asked which MCP servers in the configs are unpinned.
tasks.intent: Report MCP servers whose package or image version is not pinned.
